summary: Explain sensory encoding as converting useful world information into an imperfect artificial percept.
outcomes: Compare sensory prostheses by signal path and perceptual goal.
Explain why useful perception requires learning and task-level evaluation.
sequence: Follow sound through a cochlear-implant system
Compare auditory, retinal/cortical and tactile routes
Introduce limited channels and encoding choices

visual.question: How can a limited artificial signal still support a useful task?
